section_summary.extract_value: This section describes using the Authentic Pride subscale of the Body and Appearance Self-Conscious Emotions Scale (BASES-AP) to measure body pride, with 6 items rated 1 (Never) to 5 (Always) and averaged. It reports internal consistency for the subscale in the present study (Cronbach's α = .95 in women and .97 in men) and cites North American adult data supporting the BASES subscales' psychometrics. The section does not report sample size, demographics, BMI, survey method, or correlations with BMI.
section_summary.evidence_source: To measure body pride, we used the Authentic Pride subscale of the Body and Appearance Self-Conscious Emotions Scale (BASES-AP; Castonguay et al., 2014). Items were rated on a 5-point scale, ranging from 1 (Never) to 5 (Always), and scores were averaged so that higher scores reflect greater authentic body pride. In the present study, Cronbach's a for this subscale was .95 in women and .97 in men.
